_what_this_is: A held-out image set: written after the first image reading was taken and used to pick nothing, so it tests whether that reading generalises.
_why_they_exist: the first set both produced the reading and motivated its diagnosis, so on its own it cannot say whether 12/16 was a property of the model or of those sixteen pictures
source: hand-written in this project's own session (seek-opensource-task), 2026-10-25, after calibration/vision/measured.json was produced
question: Do you need to do something about this message? Answer act or ignore.

labels.act: the picture shows something this bot must act on
labels.ignore: the picture shows nothing this bot must act on

design_note: Same construction rule as cases.json — every caption is deliberately uninformative — but different pictures, and deliberately including the classes the first set missed (a disk gauge, a failed deploy, a Chinese failure screenshot, a traffic chart that fell to zero) so that this set can fail the model rather than flatter it.

cases.label: act
cases.note: 顶部 ALERTING 横幅＋44% 失败率
